quote: For a long time we kept postponing our rebrand at wezeo, because we could not describe who we are without falling back on buzzwords. Marek helped us break through that. He took our scattered ideas and shaped them into a clear, practical brand system that we now use every day, from sales decks to our website. What I valued most was how he worked: he asked the right questions, genuinely listened, and kept refining until the result felt true to us, not just good-looking. He is growing fast and delivers what he promises. I would gladly work with him again.
name: Matija Kadanec

quote: Some people take just tasks. Marek always go deeper, and takes full responsibility. For WEZEO's presence at TechBBQ, he designed our booth materials, presentation and print materials. I handed it over to him and did not have to worry about it again. He kept me updated, handled various changes and delivered everything. That is rare and it is exactly what makes him great to work with.
name: Veronika Petran

quote: I mentored Marek from his first steps in UX and watched him quickly grow into a designer who cares about every pixel. On the Propodnikave redesign, he co-led the design direction, rebuilt the information architecture and championed a mobile-first approach that increased returning users by 40%, all while coordinating five developers. At Skyro, he mentored junior designers with patience and real empathy. On eDesk at Slovensko.sk, a national platform used by millions, he showed the maturity and sense of responsibility that such a project demands. Curious, collaborative and reliable, he’s someone I would gladly work with again.
name: Richard Egyed

quote: I worked with Marek throughout most of my time at Wezeo. He has a strong creative mindset and always brought valuable ideas and fresh perspectives to our projects. Whether it was branding, websites, or UI/UX, he always came up with interesting and thoughtful solutions. He is reliable, responsible, and a great person to collaborate with.
name: Nela Skovajsová

quote: Marek gave Stelinhome everything we needed to stand on our own online: a brand, a website with direct booking and templates we use every week. Building our presence is now simple, and guests can reserve a stay in a few clicks. He understood our business, not just the visuals. Highly recommended.
name: Laco Holly

quote: Marek showed leadership long before anyone gave him a title. At Skyro, he mentored younger students in design six hours a week, next to his job as a designer at WEZEO. The students trusted him because he taught from real experience, not theory. He did not just share knowledge, he helped others grow. Any team that gives him people to lead will see the same.
name: Viktória Ondrejička Jakubovičová
